text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Kawalan Bekalan (Larangan Penjualan dan Pembelian Barang Kawalan)

(Petrol RON 95) 2026.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 April 2026.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini—

"kenderaan motor asing" ertinya suatu kenderaan motor yang didaftarkan oleh

pihak berkuasa yang sepatutnya di suatu negara asing;

"petrol RON 95" ertinya produk yang diperoleh daripada petroleum dalam bentuk

minyak dengan nombor oktana penyelidikan 95.

Larangan penjualan petrol RON 95

3. (1) Tiada seorang pun boleh menjual petrol RON 95 kepada mana-mana orang

bagi kegunaan kenderaan motor asing tanpa kebenaran bertulis Pengawal.

(2) Mana-mana orang yang melanggar subperaturan (1) melakukan

suatu kesalahan.

Larangan pembelian petrol RON 95

4. (1) Tertakluk kepada subperaturan (2), tiada seorang pun boleh membeli

petrol RON 95 bagi kegunaan kenderaan motor asing tanpa kebenaran bertulis Pengawal.

(2) Subperaturan (1) tidak terpakai bagi pembelian petrol RON 95 di tempat

yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual, dengan syarat bahawa—

(a) petrol RON 95 yang dibeli daripada tempat tersebut tidak boleh

diangkut bagi apa-apa urus niaga selanjutnya yang lain; dan

(b) petrol RON 95 itu hendaklah dibeli dalam harga pasaran.

(3) Mana-mana orang yang melanggar peraturan ini melakukan

suatu kesalahan.

Permohonan bagi kebenaran bertulis

5. (1) Permohonan bagi kebenaran bertulis untuk menjual atau membeli

petrol RON 95 bagi kegunaan kenderaan motor asing hendaklah dibuat kepada Pengawal

mengikut cara yang ditentukan oleh Pengawal.

(2) Pengawal boleh memberi kebenaran bertulis tertakluk kepada syarat yang

difikirkannya patut untuk mengelakkan penyalahgunaan kebenaran bertulis.

(3) Pengawal boleh, pada bila-bila masa selepas pemberian kebenaran

bertulis, menambah, memotong atau mengubah syarat yang baginya kebenaran bertulis

itu tertakluk.

(4) Pengawal boleh membatalkan suatu kebenaran bertulis pada bila-bila

masa jika orang yang kepadanya kebenaran bertulis itu diberi melanggar syarat

kebenaran bertulis itu.

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (PROHIBITION OF SALE AND

PURCHASE OF CONTROLLED ARTICLE) (RON 95 PETROL) REGULATIONS 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraphs 6(2)(a), (c) and (n) of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Control of Supplies

(Prohibition of Sale and Purchase of Controlled Article) (RON 95 Petrol)

Regulations 2026.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 April 2026.

Interpretation

2. In these Regulations—

"foreign motor vehicle" means a motor vehicle which is registered by the proper

authority of a foreign country;

"RON 95 petrol" means a product derived from petroleum in the form of oil with

a research octane number of 95.

Prohibition of sale of RON 95 petrol

3. (1) No person shall sell RON 95 petrol to any person for use in a foreign motor

vehicle without the written permission of the Controller.

(2) Any person who contravenes subregulation (1) commits an offence.

Prohibition of purchase of RON 95 Petrol

4. (1) Subject to subregulation (2), no person shall purchase RON 95 petrol for

use in a foreign motor vehicle without the written permission of the Controller.

(2) Subregulation (1) shall not apply to the purchase of RON 95 petrol at the

places as specified in the Schedule, provided that—

(a) the RON 95 petrol purchased from those places shall not be

transported for any further dealings; and

(b) the RON 95 petrol is purchased at the market price.

(3) Any person who contravenes this regulation commits an offence.

Application for written permission

5. (1) An application for a written permission to sell or purchase RON 95 petrol

for use in a foreign motor vehicle shall be made to the Controller in the manner

as may be determined by the Controller.

(2) The Controller may grant a written permission subject to such condition

as he thinks fit to prevent the misuse of the written permission.

(3) The Controller may, at any time after the grant of written permission,

add to, delete or vary the condition to which the written permission is subject.

(4) The Controller may revoke a written permission at any time if the person

to whom the written permission is granted contravenes the condition of the

written permission.
